finalText:
I've now screenshotted all six artboards, and none of the five existing ones was changed by my edit. They only share the CSS file, where I added new styles that nothing else uses.

Two of them do look cluttered in the screenshots, but that comes from the board, not from my change:

- **Changes:** the board's stickies and arrows cover almost the whole artboard.
- **Publish:** some of the board's text notes show faintly over the left side.

The board puts its stickies in the same space as the artboards, so they were sitting on top of Changes before I started. That's also why I moved the new artboard down. I didn't move any stickies, because that would rearrange other people's board. If you want them out of the way of the artboards, you could drag the Onboarding section aside, or ask me to.

The new Onboarding feedback artboard shows cleanly, and Save a version, Nothing to save and Publish rejected look normal.
